name: app-shater-user-roles-and-journey-maps-for-client-and-craftsman
title: Shater user roles: client and craftsman journey maps as orange numbered stepping-stone paths
whatItIs: A light page with an Arabic 'تحديد الأدوار والوظائف' (Defining Roles and Functions) heading, two persona blocks (Client — the one with the need; Craftsman — the experienced one) each with a photo, phone screens and a five-step zig-zag journey path (search, create request, receive offers, choose craftsman, pay and track).
whatItMeans: Grounded and clear; the zig-zag path turns an abstract user journey into a simple walk with five stops.
techniques: Map a journey as a zig-zag path of numbered stops.
Pair each persona with their own device screens.
Repeat the same path shape for every persona.

vocabulary.definition: A visual sequence of a user's steps toward a goal.
A zig-zag line connecting sequential steps.
